name: progress-circle
title: Progress Circle
description: A circular progress indicator with SVG ring, multiple sizes, customizable color, and optional centered text content. Uses namespace exports: ProgressCircle.Root.

migration.guide: v2.0.0: size prop changed from string union ('80' | '72' | etc.) to any number. Replace size="80" with size={80}. The tv dependency is no longer needed.

docs.lead: A circular progress indicator with SVG ring, any pixel size, customizable color, and optional centered text content.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Progress circles at any pixel size. Stroke width scales proportionally.
examples.code:
<ProgressCircle.Root size={80} value={75}>75%</ProgressCircle.Root>
<ProgressCircle.Root size={56} value={75}>75%</ProgressCircle.Root>
<ProgressCircle.Root size={36} value={75} />

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the circle in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Tailwind stroke class for the progress ring color

props.name: children
props.description: Content displayed centered inside the circle
